name: GS-SLAM
definition: A SLAM method that proposes an adaptive 3D Gaussian expanding strategy to add new 3D Gaussians into the training stage and delete unreliable ones with captured depths and rendered opacity values.
summary: GS-SLAM is a SLAM method using 3D Gaussian Splatting that distinguishes itself via an adaptive strategy to dynamically add and delete Gaussians based on depth and opacity.
